main_text.p: conderant se in spelunca in Makeda.
17 Et nunciatum est Iosue his verbis,Inueти sunt quinque reges abscon-diti in spelunca in Makeda.
18 Tunc dixit Iosue, Deuoluite saxa magna ad os speluncæ, & constituite iuxta eā viros vt custodiant eos.
19 Vos autem persequimini inimicos vestros, & caudam eorū cædite, nec finatis eos ingredi vrbes suas: tradidit enim eos Iehoua Deus vester in manum vestram.
20 Quum autem finem fecisset Iosue, & filii Israel percutiendi plaga magna valde donec consumerentur, & superstites qui euaserant ex ipsis ingressi essent vrbes munitas,
21 Reuerfi sunt vniuersus populus ad castra ad Iosue in Makeda in pace: non mouit contra filios Israel quisquam linguam suam.
22 Tunc dixit Iosue, Aperite os speluncæ, & adducite ad me quinque

page.notes: Handwritten marginal annotations in the left margin are ink marks, not transcribed. Verse 17 "Inueти" appears garbled in the printed text; the original reads "Inuenti" and is copied as best seen. Verse numbers are printed in italic/large form; the number "17" is set in a different type.
